item.title: Money operations accept idempotency_key first
item.content: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check it first, before any state validation: scan `ledgerly.audit.events()` for an entry with the same key and return the original record without reapplying. Pass `idempotency_key` into the `audit.record(...)` call.
